fields.name: schema_version
fields.definition: Schema id of the record or document.

fields.name: event_id
fields.definition: Identity of one emitted record. Minted once, persisted with the record before first export, unchanged on every retry. Never a logical id.

fields.name: supersedes_event_id
fields.definition: A correction is a new record naming the one it supersedes; originals are never rewritten.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.definition: Tenant the record belongs to. A self-reported value is a claim until the Node binds it to the authenticated sender.

fields.name: agent_id, system_id, deployment_id, release_id, environment, workload_id
fields.lives_in: T existing keys, newly on wire spans and markers
fields.definition: Deployment identity block, validated like `service.name`.

fields.name: source_id, source_epoch, source_sequence
fields.definition: Order within one producer epoch. Sequences are per source; there is no global order.

fields.name: sequence_unit
fields.definition: What one sequence number counts on this source.

fields.name: run_id
fields.definition: Logical run.

fields.name: scope_id
fields.definition: One `fabric.wire.run()` block entry.

fields.name: parent_run_id
fields.definition: Run that started this run (sub-agent, worker).

fields.name: resumed_from_run_id
fields.definition: Run this run resumes, when the resumed work uses a new run id. Reusing the same run id across processes is the primary mechanism.

fields.name: run_links
fields.definition: Other related runs (fan-in, batch parent).

fields.name: session_id
fields.definition: Application session across runs. Keyed pseudonym by default (decision 7).

fields.name: user_id
fields.definition: End user. Keyed pseudonym by default (decision 7).

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.definition: Application conversation. Distinct from provider conversation ids (C39) and inferred threads.

fields.name: turn_id
fields.definition: One user turn inside a conversation.

fields.name: step_id
fields.definition: Logical node, stable across retries (existing `fabric.step.id` meaning). With `attempt_id` it names one physical record.

fields.name: parent_step_id
fields.definition: Nesting parent only. Causal edges use `links`.

fields.name: attempt_id; aliases operation_id, call_id, exchange_id, decision_id
fields.definition: Physical attempt, unique in a projection. Source ids are kept as namespaced aliases and never reinterpreted as each other.

fields.name: trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id
fields.definition: Native trace position. Never synthesised from host metadata.

fields.name: links
fields.lives_in: P; T only for nesting parent
fields.definition: Typed causal links (section 2.5).

fields.name: started_at, ended_at
fields.definition: Operation interval.

fields.name: timing_basis
fields.definition: How the interval was obtained.

fields.name: observed_at, recorded_at
fields.definition: When the capture point saw it, when Fabric recorded it.

fields.name: clock_domain, clock_uncertainty_ns
fields.definition: Clock the times use; cross-source ordering never relies on wall clocks alone.

fields.name: capture_point
fields.definition: Named capture point (section 2.8) that produced the record.

fields.name: provenance
fields.definition: observed / reported / inferred.

fields.name: assertion_origin
fields.definition: Who asserted the fact (section 2.2).

fields.name: boundary
fields.definition: Where the bytes were observed.

fields.name: field evidence
fields.definition: Per-field status, reason, provenance, locator and parser version (section 2.6).

fields.name: capture_policy_ref
fields.definition: Recorder capture policy in force. Distinct from the agent's execution policy (C30-C33).

fields.name: privacy_mode, protection_status
fields.definition: Per-object privacy treatment.

fields.name: identity_mode, pseudonym_mode, key_id
fields.definition: Whether ids are pseudonymous or clear, keyed or unkeyed, and which key.

fields.name: manifest_id
fields.definition: Capture manifest in force (section 2.8).

fields.name: loss, heartbeat
fields.definition: Known loss ranges and proven ends.

fields.name: sdk_version, runtime
fields.definition: Producer versions.

fields.name: delivery receipts
fields.definition: Spooled, accepted and durable stages. Recorder v1 does not obtain them automatically.

fields.name: trigger.kind
fields.definition: What started the run.

fields.name: trigger.ref
fields.definition: Id of the ticket, message, job or alert.

fields.name: trigger.received_at
fields.definition: When the application received it.

fields.name: trigger.actor
fields.definition: Who or what initiated it.

fields.name: trigger.payload
fields.definition: Exact trigger payload.

fields.name: goal
fields.observed_by: R (never inferred from prompts or outcome)
fields.definition: Stated objective.

fields.name: constraints
fields.definition: User or application constraints on the task.

fields.name: input.kind
fields.definition: Kind of mid-run input.

fields.name: input.state
fields.definition: Received is not consumed.

fields.name: input.target
fields.definition: Run or step the input was addressed to.

fields.name: input.payload
fields.observed_by: R; P (user message in next request)
fields.definition: Exact input bytes.

fields.name: build.digest
fields.definition: Code or image digest of the running agent.

fields.name: config.digest
fields.definition: Digest of the agent configuration in force.

fields.name: configuration
fields.definition: Configuration as supplied. Never an automatic environment or repository scan.

fields.name: framework.name, framework.version
fields.definition: Agent framework in use.

fields.name: runtime.name, runtime.version
fields.definition: Language runtime and version.

fields.name: prompt.name, prompt.version
fields.definition: Template identity as the application names it.

fields.name: prompt.template
fields.definition: Unrendered template.

fields.name: instructions
fields.definition: System and developer instructions actually sent, per call.

fields.name: instructions.digest
fields.definition: Stable digest for drift and A/B comparison.

fields.name: tools_offered
fields.definition: Tools offered to the model on this call. `type`: function, custom, provider_hosted, mcp, computer, other.

fields.name: tools_offered.digest, tools_offered.count
fields.definition: Inventory digest and size.

fields.name: tools_changed
fields.observed_by: I (digest differs from the previous call in the thread)
fields.definition: Tool definition drift inside a run.

fields.name: tool_inventory
fields.definition: Tools available to the executor (not the same as offered to a model).

fields.name: mcp.server.name
fields.definition: Server name.

fields.name: mcp.server.version
fields.definition: Server version from initialization.

fields.name: mcp.protocol_version
fields.definition: Negotiated protocol version.

fields.name: mcp.transport
fields.definition: Transport.

fields.name: mcp.server.metadata
fields.definition: Capabilities and instructions exchanged at initialization.

fields.name: execution_mode
fields.definition: Customer's execution mode. Declared, not proof of enforcement.

fields.name: approval_policy
fields.definition: When approval is required.

fields.name: permissions
fields.definition: Allowed and denied tools, paths, hosts and scopes. Lists never on telemetry.

fields.name: agent_policy.id, agent_policy.version, agent_policy.digest
fields.definition: The customer's agent policy identity. Not the recorder capture policy (X31).

fields.name: model.provider, model.api
fields.definition: Provider and API dialect.

fields.name: model.endpoint_id
fields.definition: Which configured endpoint matched.

fields.name: model.requested
fields.definition: `model` in the request.

fields.name: model.served
fields.definition: Model the provider says served the call. Provider assertion.

fields.name: model.parameters
fields.definition: temperature, top_p, max tokens, stop, seed, n, stream, tool_choice, parallel tool calls, response format / output schema, reasoning effort, cache settings, as present.

fields.name: context_dependencies
fields.definition: previous_response_id, conversation, thread, cached content and file ids. `resolution`: resolved, unresolved, expired, inaccessible, unknown. Never fetched from the provider.

fields.name: provider_request_id
fields.definition: Provider request id for disputes. The only header value Fabric may read; never the header block.

fields.name: execution.host_id, execution.sandbox_id, execution.image_digest
fields.definition: Where tools ran.

fields.name: environment_snapshot
fields.definition: cwd, locale, time zone, allowlisted variables. Values of other variables never.

fields.name: step.kind
fields.definition: Closed kind of the step.

fields.name: step.label
fields.definition: Host label such as `plan` or `act`; free text, not the kind.

fields.name: actor.type
fields.definition: Who acted.

fields.name: actor.id
fields.definition: Actor id, keyed.

fields.name: actor.identity
fields.definition: Clear identity behind the pseudonym.

fields.name: actor.on_behalf_of
fields.definition: Represented principal. An agent role is not proof of user identity.

fields.name: lifecycle.state
fields.definition: State without inventing an outcome.

fields.name: result_status
fields.definition: Outcome of the operation. Transport success is not task success. Legacy `deferred` maps to lifecycle `deferred` + `unknown`.

fields.name: error.domain
fields.definition: Where the failure arose. Recorder faults are never application errors.

fields.name: error.type
fields.definition: Exception class or bounded error type.

fields.name: error.code
fields.definition: Bounded code, pattern-validated.

fields.name: error.message, stack, cause
fields.definition: Message and stack; never on telemetry.

fields.name: attempt.kind
fields.definition: Relation to other attempts. Inference only for `retry` (identical request digest after an error, `tentative`); fallback and hedge are never inferred.

fields.name: attempt.ordinal
fields.definition: Attempt number.

fields.name: retry.previous_attempt, retry.reason
fields.definition: Prior attempt and reason.

fields.name: attempt.selected
fields.definition: Which attempt's result the application used.

fields.name: workflow.id
fields.definition: Workflow instance.

fields.name: workflow.node, workflow.iteration
fields.definition: Node and loop iteration. Branches and joins use `depends_on` links.

fields.name: workflow.definition
fields.definition: Graph or plan definition.

fields.name: dispatch.kind, dispatch.id, dispatch.state
fields.definition: Queue, task, job, invocation, provider batch or webhook delivery; state produced, received, acknowledged, requeued, dead_lettered, unknown. Acknowledged is not processed.

fields.name: batch.item_index
fields.definition: Item position inside a batch.

fields.name: delegation.target
fields.definition: Agent, run or service delegated to.

fields.name: delegation.protocol, delegation.depth
fields.definition: How and how deep.

fields.name: delegation.state
fields.definition: Hand-off state.

fields.name: delegation.payload
fields.definition: What was handed over.

fields.name: checkpoint.id, checkpoint.state_hash
fields.definition: Checkpoint identity.

fields.name: checkpoint.action
fields.definition: What happened to the checkpoint.

fields.name: checkpoint.state
fields.definition: State, when exposed. Fabric never forces a checkpoint or flush.

fields.name: stream.state
fields.definition: How the stream ended.

fields.name: stream.first_chunk_offset_ns
fields.definition: Time from request start to first response chunk.

fields.name: stream.chunk_boundaries_retained
fields.definition: Wire capture concatenates bodies: `false`. Chunk timing is not part of the record.

fields.name: cancellation.state, cancellation.requested_by
fields.definition: Cancellation requested versus observed.

fields.name: deadline
fields.definition: Deadline the operation ran under.

fields.name: scope.exit_status
fields.definition: How the `fabric.wire.run()` block exited. Not the run outcome (D30).

fields.name: model.exchange.request, model.exchange.response
fields.definition: Body bytes at the declared boundary. Not headers, TLS frames or provider receipt.

fields.name: model.exchange.parts
fields.definition: Inline media and binary parts extracted so text is never lost to one large part (section 7.4).

fields.name: input.messages
fields.definition: Messages sent to the model. role: system, developer, user, assistant, tool, other. Model-bound history, not application messages.

fields.name: output.messages
fields.definition: Messages and items the model returned.

fields.name: content.parts
fields.type: list {type, media_type, sha256, byte_length, mode, locator}
fields.definition: type: text, image, audio, video, document, file_ref, tool_use, tool_result, reasoning, refusal, other. mode: embedded or reference_only. URLs and provider file ids are never dereferenced.

fields.name: refusal
fields.definition: Provider refusal content.

fields.name: finish_reasons
fields.definition: Closed vocabulary; anything else is `other`.

fields.name: reasoning.format
fields.definition: Form in which the provider returned reasoning.

fields.name: reasoning.text
fields.definition: `captured` only for returned plaintext; otherwise `redacted(provider_encrypted / provider_redacted)` or `not_captured(provider_summarised / provider_not_returned)`. Never a claim to hidden reasoning.

fields.name: reasoning.summary
fields.definition: Provider summary of reasoning.

fields.name: reasoning.object
fields.definition: Opaque or encrypted reasoning blob, kept because it is part of the exact bytes.

fields.name: tool_call.id
fields.definition: Provider tool-call id, keyed (decision 8).

fields.name: tool_call.name, tool_call.type
fields.definition: Tool requested by the model.

fields.name: tool_call.arguments
fields.definition: Arguments the model emitted.

fields.name: tool_call.result_as_fed
fields.definition: Result as the agent told the model (boundary `provider_bound`).

fields.name: tool_call.links
fields.definition: Model call to tool call to the call that consumed the result. Unmatched ids stay `unresolved`.

fields.name: tool.execution.arguments, tool.execution.result
fields.definition: What the tool actually received and returned.

fields.name: tool.execution_side
fields.definition: Where the tool ran.

fields.name: provider_tool.kind
fields.definition: Hosted tool items in Responses and Anthropic server tools.

fields.name: provider_tool.status
fields.definition: Provider assertion; execution inside the provider is not observed.

fields.name: provider_tool.inputs, outputs, citations, files
fields.definition: Queries, results, citations, generated file references.

fields.name: mcp.method, mcp.direction
fields.definition: JSON-RPC method and direction.

fields.name: mcp.session_id, mcp.jsonrpc_id
fields.definition: Session and request ids, for progress and cancel pairing.

fields.name: mcp.request, mcp.response, mcp.notification
fields.definition: Exact JSON-RPC bytes where observed. Resources, prompts, sampling and elicitation included in P4.

fields.name: mcp.error.kind
fields.definition: Protocol error versus tool error result.

fields.name: retrieval.query, retrieval.filters
fields.definition: Query text or vector and filters.

fields.name: retrieval.top_k, retrieval.index_id, retrieval.result_count
fields.definition: Search shape.

fields.name: retrieval.results
fields.type: list {doc_id, chunk_id, version, title, excerpt, score, score_kind, rank, source}
fields.definition: Results returned, in order. Collection completeness is declared.

fields.name: retrieval.used_in
fields.observed_by: I (excerpt digest appears in a later request, `tentative`)
fields.definition: Fetched versus used.

fields.name: memory.op, memory.store, memory.version, memory.ttl
fields.definition: Memory operation.

fields.name: memory.key, memory.value
fields.definition: Key and value read or written.

fields.name: terminal.argv, terminal.context
fields.definition: argv versus shell command, executable, cwd. Environment variable names only, never values.

fields.name: terminal.stdin
fields.definition: Input bytes the caller passed.

fields.name: terminal.stdout, terminal.stderr
fields.status_if_hook_absent: not_captured(not_exposed) when the caller reads pipes directly
fields.definition: Output the caller received. Fabric never adds a pipe consumer.

fields.name: terminal.exit_code, terminal.signal, terminal.pid
fields.definition: Exit status and process id (joins host sensors).

fields.name: remote.target, remote.host_key_verified
fields.definition: Target and the client's host-key assertion.

fields.name: remote.request, remote.result, remote.stream
fields.definition: Command and channel bytes, client side. Remote side out of scope.

fields.name: db.system, db.namespace
fields.definition: Engine and database.

fields.name: db.statement, db.parameters
fields.definition: Statement and bound parameters.

fields.name: db.rows
fields.definition: Rows the caller actually fetched.

fields.name: db.rows_fetched, db.rows_affected
fields.definition: Unknown is distinct from zero.

fields.name: db.transaction_id
fields.definition: Transaction the statement ran in.

fields.name: http.method, http.status, http.host
fields.definition: Request shape.

fields.name: http.target, http.request_body, http.response_body, http.redirects
fields.definition: Path, query and bodies. Raw headers never.

fields.name: file.operation, file.path_hash, file.byte_range
fields.definition: An open is not a read.

fields.name: file.path
fields.lives_in: C `artifact.before`/`after` descriptor; never clear on T by default
fields.definition: Path.

fields.name: file.before, file.after
fields.definition: Bytes actually observed; a write buffer is not a full after-image.

fields.name: file.diff
fields.definition: Derived diff with algorithm and version.

fields.name: file.existence_before, file.existence_after
fields.definition: Creation and deletion evidence.

fields.name: asset
fields.definition: Files seen or produced that are not otherwise a role; or `not_captured` with digest when a cap is hit.

fields.name: asset.reference
fields.observed_by: P (URLs, provider file ids in model bytes); R
fields.definition: Reference only; never dereferenced.

fields.name: asset.media_metadata
fields.definition: Only when decoded, never guessed.

fields.name: computer.requested_action
fields.definition: Action the model asked for. Requested is not executed.

fields.name: computer.executed_action
fields.definition: Action, target, frame, coordinate system, typed text, navigation URL.

fields.name: computer.snapshot
fields.observed_by: P (screenshots sent back to the model); R; ui.automation
fields.definition: Screenshots, DOM or accessibility snapshots that already exist. Fabric never takes one.

fields.name: media.track
fields.definition: Track description.

fields.name: media.frames, media.events, media.transcript
fields.definition: Frames, turn and interruption events, gaps, playback acknowledgments, transcripts.

fields.name: application_message
fields.definition: Agent-to-agent or app-to-user message that is not a model exchange.

fields.name: output.payload
fields.definition: What the application emitted, after any post-processing.

fields.name: embedding.input, embedding.dimensions
fields.definition: Embedded input; vectors are not copied into the projection.

fields.name: control.id
fields.definition: One control observation.

fields.name: control.kind
fields.definition: What kind of external control.

fields.name: control.phase
fields.definition: Approvals are a request and a later resolution, linked by `resolves`.

fields.name: control.decision
fields.definition: Decision the external control made. Legacy `requires_review` maps to `escalate`. Unknown is never mapped to allow.

fields.name: control.resolves
fields.definition: Request this resolution answers.

fields.name: control.gated_step, control.action_id
fields.definition: Step or action it applied to. A denied action may have no executed step.

fields.name: control.decided_by
fields.definition: human_approver, system or external_service.

fields.name: control.policy_id, policy_version, policy_digest
fields.definition: Policy the control applied.

fields.name: control.proof_ref
fields.definition: Reference to the external system's own record. Fabric does not verify it.

fields.name: control.checked, control.reason, control.approval
fields.definition: What was checked, why, and the scope and duration of a grant.

fields.name: control.authentication, control.enforced_by_fabric
fields.definition: Invariants on every control event.

fields.name: selection.kind, selection.reason
fields.definition: An exposed routing choice and its category.

fields.name: selection.decision
fields.definition: Candidates, selected option, reason text.

fields.name: context_change.kind, context_change.trigger
fields.definition: Explicit context change.

fields.name: context_change.tokens_before, tokens_after, token_basis
fields.definition: Token counts name their basis.

fields.name: context_change.affected
fields.definition: Dropped items and summary.

fields.name: context.history_rewritten
fields.definition: Inferred only. Never labelled compaction: shared prefixes also arise from forks and parallel calls.

fields.name: effect.id, type, operation, target_system, target, idempotency_key
fields.definition: The effect and its target.

fields.name: effect.state
fields.definition: Intent is not acceptance; acceptance is not application.

fields.name: effect.timing
fields.definition: Duration of the effect.

fields.name: effect.request, effect.result
fields.definition: Request and result.

fields.name: effect.caused_by
fields.definition: Tool call that produced the effect.

fields.name: commit.state
fields.definition: HTTP 200, SQL success or a tool's text is not durable commit.

fields.name: commit.basis
fields.definition: Legacy `committed=True` without an explicit value maps to `legacy_default`.

fields.name: commit.receipt
fields.definition: Service acknowledgment or authoritative state.

fields.name: compensation.state
fields.definition: Reversal recorded; Fabric never executes one.

fields.name: outcome.channel_kind, outcome.target
fields.definition: Where the output went.

fields.name: outcome.delivery_state
fields.definition: Stages are never inferred from each other.

fields.name: outcome.delivery_evidence
fields.definition: Recipient, channel and receipt detail.

fields.name: run.outcome, run.stop_reason
fields.definition: Application-declared disposition. Integrity verdicts are not outcomes.

fields.name: usage.input_tokens, usage.output_tokens
fields.definition: Provider-reported usage.

fields.name: usage.cache_read, cache_creation, reasoning tokens
fields.definition: Overlap between counters is declared to prevent double counting.

fields.name: usage.media_units, usage.hosted_tool_calls
fields.definition: Non-token units.

fields.name: usage.basis
fields.definition: Fabric never estimates in v1: `provider_reported` or `unknown`.

fields.name: cost
fields.definition: Pricing and billing are downstream (decision 11). Provider-returned cost fields stay in the stored bytes, unprojected.
